note: Little Blue NRD recreation area on a 75-acre spring-fed no-wake lake, 4 mi east + 1/4 mi south of Ohiowa. The electric back-in pads line the west side of the park road, ~80-110 m from the water across the road, lawn and day-use area. Three restrooms (primitive), water wells, storm shelters; nearest dump ~6 mi north at Milligan. Swimming beach, boat ramp, floating dock, fishing pier, trails. Power/water Apr 1-Dec 1. Big-rig friendly. --Claude
summary: NRD page + July 2026 rules + 2021 fee schedule: 19 electric pads (30/50 A), $20/night, FIRST-COME only with a 14-day limit (stored reservable: true was wrong -> false, fcfs always). Pads sit behind the park road ~80-110 m from the lake: lakefront -> lakeview lead. Pin ~45 m from the pad row, fine. Phone 402-364-2145 matches Google. Note cleaned ('contact NRD for booking' and 'free tent camping anywhere' contradicted).
flags: BOOKING corrected: the derived reservable: true (from the old note's 'Contact NRD for booking') is contradicted by the NRD's July 2026 regulations: 'Campsites are provided on a first-come, first-served basis' and 01.05D prohibits holding sites. Now reservable false, fcfs always, max 14 consecutive days in 30.

WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (lead): on imagery the 19 pads are angled back-in spurs on the WEST side of the park road (row centre ~40.41468,-97.38130); between them and the shore lie the road, a paved walk, a shelter/restroom, open lawn and the swim beach (day use). The water's edge is ~80-110 m east of the pads. Open sightline across mown grass, so a view, not frontage: the campground's own loop road blocks on-water under the 2026-11-01 rulings.

TENTS: the old note's 'free tent camping anywhere' is contradicted: the Lone Star rules (05.01A) permit tent camping 'in designated areas' with 'Daily camping fees ... required', and the fee schedule allows tents on the electric sites at no extra charge. Dropped from the note.
PIN fine: stored 40.41490,-97.38085 is on the lawn east of the road ~45 m from the pad row centre.
PHONE 402-364-2145 matches Google's panel (the NRD office). Website https://littlebluenrd.org/recreation/ is the operator's page (a #Lone_Star anchor exists).
